text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The day after I got my box of<n>haskaps, I spot
Hokko Tarumae. I<n>figure I should relay how happy
the<n>farmer was to hear about her, so I<n>start heading
over.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... Why is my audience<n>retention always so
bad? Was the<n>cutesy naive bumpkin character the
wrong pick for a tourism<n>ambassador?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I need a more striking idol<n>persona... I could
try a rockstar, like<n>"What's up, Tokyooo?! Get
ready to<n>rock, Tomakomai style!" ...or<n>something like
that?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Or maybe I should go more energetic?<n>And do
Tomakomai-themed comedy<n>sketches... No. The
innocent cutesy<n>type I've been doing should have
the<n>most mass appeal.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Maybe the problem is my time slot,<n>not my
character. Later at night... isn't<n>happening, so I
could try earlier? Like<n>greeting people on their way
to school<n>and work...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Y-you, you didn't overhear that, did<n>you?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ooh...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I... uh, um! I realize this is my own<n>fault for thinking
out loud, but... please,<n>don't tell anyone about this.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Y'know, that I was strategizing<n>popularity... That the
whole cutesy idol<n>thing is just an act!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I-it's all a trade secret, okay?! I'll<n>consider any
leaks to be obstruction<n>of business, so don't you
dare!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Please, please don't! ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I recognize you. You were at<n>my street
show the other day,<n>weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Of course I do! An idol's gotta at least<n>remember
the faces of her<n>supporters!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If it's okay, could you tell me your<n>impression of
the show? I'm working<n>on improving it!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Just like that, I'm swept into an idol<n>strategy
meeting.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. I see, I see! Thank you so<n>much for all the
valuable feedback!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
A Tomakomai taste-testing event<n>might be a really
good idea. It seemed<n>like a lot of people were
mainly<n>interested in the music, so I'll have to<n>prep
more songs too...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She furiously scribbles away at a well<n>worn
notebook, crossing out old<n>ideas. And something
about the<n>passion in her eyes... it sticks with<n>me.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Several days later, I catch sight of<n>Hokko Tarumae
again at a<n>scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
There's only two hundred meters to<n>go, and she's
blasting ahead—three<n>lengths in the lead!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Guh!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(I have to make my move, fast! But<n>my legs feel so
heavy... I won't<n>reach!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ah... AHHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She frantically scrambles towards the<n>finish... but
ends up crossing it in<n>eleventh place.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Mmmph! Getting all mopey won't<n>help anything!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I've gotta be the star of Tomakomai!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Ever since that day...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Panting...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Just, keep runniiing!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Good morning! I'm a local idol from<n>Tomakomai
City. Let's all make<n>today a real day to remember!
♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...D-do you hear me? Let's make this<n>a great day!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Panting...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I'm, I'm wiped... but no quitting! I'll<n>do another lap!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
G-good morning! ♪ I'm holding a<n>street show in a
few days, so please<n>come see it!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...People won't even take the flyers.<n>...But I can't let
it get to me!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She spends all her time at night<n>training, and then
gets up early and<n>spends her mornings doing idol
stuff.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Panting... What's my time?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: It's worse than before...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I don't get it. It feels like the more I<n>run, the worse I
get at it...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Urrrgh, I won't give up!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's clearly overworking herself...<n>There has to be
something I can do to<n>ease some of the stress, but
what?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I don't really know her or what shedoes to relax. There's only one thingI know she likes, and that's...
